tagline: Create meaningful connections between companies and their ideal customers
hero_kpi_rationale: The core of the business model relies on AI to drive user acquisition and advertising optimization through Axon, the primary growth engine and key differentiator versus competitors.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue generated from AI-powered advertising solutions, primarily via Axon Ads Manager.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth driven by AI applied to mobile advertising
kpis.description: Axon Ads Manager, powered by AI, represents nearly all of the revenue. Growth is driven by increased efficiency of advertising campaigns.

kpis.explanation_en: Adjusted operating profit, excluding non-recurring and non-cash items.
kpis.signal: Adjusted profitability rising sharply due to model efficiency
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA reflects underlying operating performance, growing strongly as the model scales.

kpis.explanation_en: Net result from continuing operations divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.signal: Very high margin, typical of a low marginal cost software and AI model
kpis.description: Net margin on continuing operations reaches 62.6% in 2025, significantly improving due to the efficiency of the technology and AI model.

kpis.explanation_en: Research and development expenses divided by total revenue.
kpis.signal: Sharp reduction in R&D spending following optimization
kpis.description: The R&D-to-revenue ratio declines significantly, reflecting technological stabilization or rationalization of technology investments.

kpis.explanation_en: Depreciation, amortization and asset write-offs to maintain technological infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Capex stable, primarily directed toward technology infrastructure
kpis.description: Depreciation, amortization and write-offs amount to $130.7M in 2025, primarily related to technology infrastructure and operating assets.

ai_positioning.summary: AppLovin positions AI as central to its strategy. The company emphasizes its mission to deliver end-to-end AI-powered advertising solutions, with Axon Ads Manager as the flagship product powered by the Axon AI recommendation engine. AI is presented as a key differentiator enabling optimized ad placements and improved advertiser ROI at scale.
evidence: Item 1. Business: Our mission is to create meaningful connections between companies and their ideal customers. We provide end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered (AI) advertising solutions
Axon Ads Manager is powered by our Axon AI advertising recommendation engine and matches advertiser demand with publisher supply through auctions at vast scale and at microsecond-level speeds
As our distribution grows, we gain better insights for Axon AI, which then further enhances the efficiency and effectiveness of the Axon Ads Manager

risks.title: Cyberattacks and Security Incidents
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to increasingly sophisticated and large-scale cyberattacks, improper data access, or other cybersecurity incidents, which could result in data loss, service interruptions, and reputational damage.

risks.title: Fluctuations in Operating Results
risks.score_rationale: The company's operating results may fluctuate significantly from period to period, which could affect investor confidence and stock value.

risks.title: Dependence on Technology and Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology and IT infrastructure for its operations, making it vulnerable to technical issues, infrastructure limitations, and service disruptions.

risks.title: Regulation and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly regarding data protection and privacy, which could negatively impact its business and operating costs.

risks.title: Competition in the Advertising Ecosystem
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with powerful rivals possessing significant resources, which could impact its market share and margins.

risks.title: Dependence on Third-Party Platforms
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on third-party platforms (Meta, Google) for distribution and data access, making it vulnerable to policy changes by these partners.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Employees and Talent Retention
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on certain key employees and on attracting critical engineering talent, which could negatively impact innovation and performance if such individuals depart.
